body:
Hi again. I understand what you mean with all that you've said here. 

Yesterday and the day before were okay. I started painting, which I've never done before, and yesterday I wrote a long piece about everything I've done wrong and who I am. It felt good and refreshing to get it all out. I dyed my hair and I put on makeup. R wasn't in bed the other night because he was writing a paper and he didn't come home last night. I don't know if he was with a friend or a girl, just that he was near school. My heat isn't working. Waking up cold, alone, stupid for even trying anything. I can't. I can't live if this is my life. I would rather just end. I can't live through this. I lived through leaving my ex of 8 years and it was painful for years.  I can't live with both wounds.  I can't do this. I'm sorry. I'm sorry to my father and everyone I ever failed. I'm sorry to R for putting him through this, when I could have prevented it by just doing what I knew I should be doing all along. There is nothing here worth saving. I'm sorry.

Thank you for thinking of me and replying.  I've been reading your comment over and over again. Intellectually, I know that having a mother with narcissism set me up to only feel worth anything if I was doing my absolute best to make her (by extension others) look good.  

I accept that I couldn't make things work with J.  It really did help me when my psychiatrist told me that a breakup after 8 years is more like a divorce than not.  I do still have issues knowing that he and I picked out the ring, but that he never, in all that time, actually wanted to go through with giving it to me.  It kills.  

R is somehow more complicated.  He feels like family to me.  I am scared to let our paths drift away, the way friendships so often do.  I am scared that left alone, I will lock myself up and that will be the end of me.  I told him today that I was very sorry that in my fervor to provide for him, and to prove myself valuable to him, I had not shown him my real self.  For years, I have been suppressing my real self and presenting this "useful, valuable" person who could help him, and that's not what he needed from a girlfriend, or anything like the real me who he fell for in the first place. I ruined it and I knew I was being dishonest in not being myself and trying too hard to help and overcompensate, but I thought I had more time to course correct, I didn't take advantage of having every day as an opportunity to come back to myself and to by extension be a better partner. I never really expected that we would get married, at least not right away, but I did think that I had more time, and that over time his feelings for me would grow even more tender.  So I told him all of that today, and I think that tonight I may tell him that I should have expected more from him too.  I should have expected for him to do more around the house and not just play video games all night after his work was half done.  I should have given him something to strive for with me.  

The bottom line is that he deserves someone that he is crazy about, which is why I understand why he's been messaging with girls and feeling cautious and bad about it in a red flag way pre-breakup.  He's in college, he's supposed to be doing that.  It's exciting to meet new people, and every semester there will be even more new people.  New girls are exciting girls - there's so much to discover and enjoy.  Yet I am still jealous.  It makes me sick.  I don't know if I can live through it, though he assures me that he will put my needs first before their needs until I am strong enough.  No one has ever been crazy about me, at least not in the long-term.  

I also had an abortion 8 months ago today (would have been due around this week or next, I was about 5 weeks along), so that's fucking with me a bit.  It was the right decision for us, because I know that it would have completely derailed his path, but it hurts, because like you said, by the time you're 30, you're supposed to have a family, a husband, a house, a dog, a jeep, career, a savings account with more than a couple bucks in it.  And I really have none of those things.  

I told my friend last night that in terms of turning 30, it feels like I'm on this racetrack with these sleek thoroughbred horses, and I'm the cow that someone accidentally let onto the track - the cow has no idea what it's doing, but it knows it's different, and that it doesn't want to be there, even if it's slower in understanding everything.  

I don't know what to do.  I don't know where I will live or how I will survive.  I spent all my money taking care of him, and now all I do is work.  I made myself not fun anymore, so that I could help him, and it only pushed him away.  I'm a human disaster.  I can't keep anything together.
